name: MedExQA
intro: MedExQA是覆盖五个代表不足医学专业的英文多选问答基准，共965道题，每题配两份写作风格不同且经过人工核验的解释。数据来自公开模拟测试和考试，经过重复项、BERT语义近重复及法律法规题筛除，并划分为25条开发集和940条测试集，用于联合评估答案分类与解释生成。
build_method: 公开考试汇集, 去重过滤, 双解释构建, 人工核验
eval_feature: 五个低代表专业, 每题双解释, 答案错误时解释得分归零
build_method_en: Public-exam aggregation, deduplication and filtering, dual-explanation construction, human validation
eval_feature_en: Five underrepresented specialties, two explanations per item, zero explanation score for wrong answers
intro_en: MedExQA is an English multiple-choice QA benchmark spanning five underrepresented medical specialties. Its 965 questions each have two human-validated explanations in distinct writing styles. Public mock tests and exams are deduplicated, filtered for BERT semantic similarity and law or regulation content, then split into 25 development and 940 test items for joint answer-classification and explanation-generation evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.06331, the BioNLP 2024 paper, and the official knowlab/MedExQA repository rather than a downstream QuarkMed reference. The diagrams preserve five underrepresented specialties and exact counts of 148 biomedical engineering, 377 clinical laboratory science, 111 clinical psychology, 194 occupational therapy, and 135 speech-language pathology questions; public mock-test and exam collection; exact and BERT-cosine near-duplicate removal; manual-keyword filtering of law and regulation items; answer-option shuffling; two distinct human-validated explanations per item; the exact 965-item release with a five-per-specialty 25-item development set and 940-item test set; 18 open baselines, three GPT models, and MedPhi-2 under zero-shot temperature-zero evaluation; logits or regex/fuzzy answer parsing; BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and SciBERT BERTScore with explanation score zeroed for wrong answers; and three-MSc-annotator 0/0.5/1 human validation on the development set.
